newsitem.title: USA: CBOT nearby soyoil ends firmer as Morocco buys.
newsitem.headline: CBOT nearby soyoil ends firmer as Morocco buys.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures closed firmer in the nearby months on commercial buying which may have been linked to news Morocco bought 49,500 tonnes of optional-origin vegetable oil, traders said.
Soyoil futures began to firm in late trading amid talk China was seeking four or five cargoes of soybean oil but U.S. exporters said there was no evidence of Chinese demand.
However, exporters confirmed that Morocco bought the vegetable oil for November-December shipment.
Cargill Inc, Produce Grain and Term Commodities were key purchasers of December soyoil futures, the traders said.
Soymeal closed lower in step with a drop in soybeans plus oil meal spreading and fund selling.
Good crop weather in the U.S. Midwest and the fund selling drove soymeal sharply lower and limited gains in soyoil.
Soyoil closed 0.10 cent per lb higher to 0.30 lower, with October up 0.09 at 23.95 cents. Soymeal was $5.60 per ton lower to $1.70 higher, with October down $5.60 at $248.90.
